name: Alamo Quarry Market
summary: Alamo Quarry Market is an upscale open-air lifestyle center in San Antonio featuring major retailers, eclectic dining options, and a 16-screen cinema in a modern, pedestrian-friendly setting. Located in the city's affluent north-central area, this shopping destination combines quality retail with entertainment and community events, creating a vibrant gathering place for discerning shoppers.
demographics: Alamo Quarry Market attracts an affluent, educated demographic from San Antonio's north-central neighborhoods, with primary visitors aged 30-65 representing upper-middle to high-income households. The trade area includes nearby Alamo Heights, Terrell Hills, and Lincoln Heights, known for above-average household incomes and professional occupations. Shoppers typically seek quality dining experiences, specialty retail, and entertainment options in an upscale open-air environment. The center draws both local residents for everyday needs and destination visitors for its cinema and restaurant collection, with a customer base that values convenience and lifestyle amenities over discount shopping.
description: Alamo Quarry Market stands as one of San Antonio's premier open-air shopping and entertainment destinations, located at 255 East Basse Road in the city's affluent north-central corridor. Built on the site of a historic cement quarry, this lifestyle center has transformed into a modern retail complex that seamlessly blends major national retailers with distinctive dining establishments and entertainment venues. The center features an airy, pedestrian-friendly design that encourages visitors to explore its diverse mix of apparel stores, home goods retailers, and specialty shops, all set within a contemporary architectural framework. A key attraction is the Regal Alamo Quarry Stadium 16 cinema, complementing an eclectic collection of restaurants that range from casual eateries to upscale dining options. With convenient amenities including electric vehicle charging stations and extended operating hours (10 AM to 9 PM Monday through Saturday, 12 PM to 6 PM on Sunday), Alamo Quarry Market serves as both a neighborhood gathering place and a regional shopping destination. The center's commitment to creating a vibrant community atmosphere is evident through its regular events, entertainment programming, and guest services, all managed and leased by American Assets Trust. Its strategic location near major thoroughfares and proximity to San Antonio's most desirable residential neighborhoods has established Alamo Quarry Market as a cornerstone of upscale retail and lifestyle experiences in the region.
